items.title: Show HN: PS2 games statically recompiled to WebAssembly
items.summary: 📝 The game's Emotion Engine machine code is translated ahead of time into C++, compiled to WebAssembly, and linked against a reimplementation of the PS2's operating system and hardware that draws with WebGPU. Most of a PS2 game's 3D work happens in microprograms the game uploads to vector unit 1. Lessons from making it fast The first race ran at 3 frames per second natively, with a software rasterizer and an interpreter for vector unit 1.🔗 Read more: https://github.com/snuri00/ps2-web-recomp
